# PROCESS — cand_0001 (iteration 1)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A. Fabricated account-holder DOB in book_reservation | 8 (3/5 fail), 20 (t0), 23 (t0,t2,t4), 35 (t2,t4) | agent invents a dob although get_user_details has it | BEHAVIORAL | in-body normalization (autocorrect from profile) |
| 2 | B. Invented payment ids / policy payment limits | 20 (t1 2 certs, t4 fake ids), 23 (t1,t3 3 certs; fake 'credit_card_7815826' copied from docstring example), 35, 44 t3 | agent builds ids from last-4 or docstring examples; ignores 1-certificate rule | RULE | in-body guards + enriched error listing real ids; strip copyable example ids from docstrings |
| 3 | C. Wrong price arithmetic / ranking (cheapest, 2nd cheapest, change cost) | 23 (all: picked $771 not $364), 35 (2nd cheapest confusion), 10 (quoted $573/$996, real $2010 → user would decline), 44 (upgrade cost) | agent adds/ranks prices by hand; doesn't know cabin change re-prices all segments | CAPABILITY-GAP | 2 new compute tools: search_itineraries_by_price, calculate_flight_change_cost |
| 4 | D. Cancelling ineligible reservations | 35 (t1,t3,t4 cancelled M20IZO economy/no-ins/>24h), 44 (t1 KC18K6/S61CZX) | agent caves to insistence | RULE / DECISION | discriminating-predicate guard in cancel_reservation (exact policy predicate) |
| 5 | E. Flight durations unavailable → transfer | 44 (t0,t4 transfer, t2 wrong) | no tool exposes scheduled times for a reservation | CAPABILITY-GAP | new tool get_reservation_flight_times |
| 6 | F. Refused legit split into separate reservations | 23 (all 5 trials) | agent invents a prohibition | KNOWLEDGE | additive docstring fact in book_reservation |
| 7 | G. Wrong connecting-leg date | 20 t4 (HAT039 dated +1 day) | misreads "+1" arrival | RULE | in-body normalization against one-stop search |
| 8 | H. Scrambled unchanged legs in flight update | 10 t2 | return legs replaced by outbound numbers | RULE | route-continuity guard in update_reservation_flights |
| 9 | I. Unwarranted goodwill certificate | 35 t1 ($200) | agent offers compensation for refused cancel | DECISION | predicate guard in send_certificate (needs cancelled/delayed flight + policy amount) |
| 10 | J. total_baggages = free allowance | 35 t2,t3 (total_baggages=2 when user has none) | knowledge confusion | KNOWLEDGE | per-param doc |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | normalization in body | book_reservation.py | passenger whose name == account holder / saved passenger gets the profile dob | fires only on mismatch; all 10 gold books unaltered |
| B | validation guards + enriched errors | book_reservation.py | payment ids must be in profile (error lists real ids w/ brand+last4/balance); ≤1 cert, ≤1 credit card, ≤3 gift cards; amount ≤ balance | all 10 gold books pass |
| G | normalization | book_reservation.py | consecutive legs matching a one-stop search pair get that pair's leg date | fires only on date mismatch |
| F, J | docstring knowledge | book_reservation.py | separate reservations allowed when user asks; total_baggages = bags actually brought; placeholder (non-copyable) example | additive |
| D | predicate guard | cancel_reservation.py | refuse unless (≤24h old OR airline-cancelled flight OR business OR insurance) and nothing flown; doc: insurance ≠ change of plan; membership irrelevant | all 11 gold cancels across tasks.json pass (incl. task 7 upgrade-then-cancel) |
| I | predicate guard | send_certificate.py | needs a cancelled/delayed flight in user's reservations; amount = 100×pax / 50×pax | no gold send_certificate exists in tasks.json |
| B, H | validation guards | update_reservation_flights.py | payment id in profile & not certificate (lists usable ids); known-route continuity check; doc step "quote first" | all 20 gold update calls pass |
| C | NEW compute tool | calculate_flight_change_cost.py | replicates env repricing exactly; returns user_will_pay | read-only |
| C | NEW compute tool | search_itineraries_by_price.py | direct+one-stop, per-cabin totals, sorted & ranked, optional earliest_departure | read-only |
| E | NEW compute tool | get_reservation_flight_times.py | per-flight times/durations, layovers, journey totals (scans other dates if flight no longer searchable) | read-only |
| C, E | docstring pointers | search_direct_flight, search_onestop_flight, get_reservation_details, update_reservation_baggages | point to the new tools; leg-date rule; remove copyable fake ids | additive |

## Verify-the-fix (local harness: tool files exec'd with env_* bound to tau2 AirlineTools on db.json)
- trace 20 t1 two certificates → "Error: at most ONE travel certificate…"; trace 20 t4 ids certificate_7815826/credit_card_7447 → error listing real ids.
- trace 20 t4 HAT039 dated 2024-05-21 + dob 1990-08-15 → booked with HAT039 2024-05-20 and dob 1990-04-05 (notes returned).
- trace 8 t1 dob 1990-03-15 → corrected to 1957-10-05; gold args for 8 → no notes (no-op).
- all 10 gold book_reservation calls in tasks.json → none blocked, none altered.
- cancel guard: M20IZO (35), HTR26G → refused; WUNA5K flown → refused; K1NW8N (23 gold), FDZ0T5/HSR97W (42 gold) → cancelled; all 11 gold cancels in tasks.json → pass.
- send_certificate(aarav_ahmed_6699, 200) (35 t1) → refused; a user with a delayed flight & correct amount → sent.
- update_reservation_flights: 10 t2 scrambled legs → continuity error; 44 t3 credit_card_7557 → error listing credit_card_4196779; all 20 gold calls → pass.
- calculate_flight_change_cost == actual env charge on 4NQLHD (2010), NM1VX1 (484), H8Q05L (163), KC18K6 (740), XEHM4B (1072).
- search_itineraries_by_price: 35 rank2 = HAT069+HAT258 $290 (gold); 20 ≥11:00 rank1 = HAT136+HAT039 $255 (gold); 23 business rank1 = HAT023 $364 / HAT204+HAT100 $507 (gold).
- get_reservation_flight_times: NM1VX1 3h/3h, KC18K6 legs 3h+2h, S61CZX 5.5h legs, H8Q05L 2.5h, WUNA5K (landed) resolved via other dates.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis (7 tasks × 5 trials was small enough to read directly); no subagents. Built a local tau2-backed harness (/tmp/ce/harness.py) to run every tool body on trace args and on ALL gold actions in tasks.json.
- No prior iterations exist (first iteration).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The cancel predicate and the payment/DOB guards are verified against every gold action in tasks.json — keep them.
- The compute tools match the env's pricing exactly; do not replace them with prose formulas.

## Deliberately skipped
- 42 t1 (cancelled a reservation of other passengers SE9KEL, business so eligible) — a judgment call; a guard ("holder must be a passenger") would block legitimate cancels.
- 42 t0 premature transfer — partially addressed by get_reservation_details doc; no transfer guard (gold task 13 needs transfer on request).
- Insurance-reason check for cancellation cannot be coded (signature frozen, no reason argument) → docstring only.
- Hallucinated extra passengers (23 t0) — no reliable general predicate.
